data.display_address: Al Fattan Crystal Towers, Jumeirah Beach Residence, Dubai
data.long_description:
Experience elevated coastal living in this expansive 3-bedroom + maid’s room apartment located in Al Fattan Crystal Towers I, one of the most sought-after beachfront residences. Offering a generous 2,273 sqft layout, this home combines space, privacy, and uninterrupted luxury views of the Arabian Gulf.

Situated on a high floor, the apartment boasts panoramic full sea views and abundant natural light throughout, creating a serene and premium living atmosphere. The unit is vacant and ready for immediate move-in, allowing you to personalize it to your own style.

3 Spacious Bedrooms

Family-friendly and vibrant coastal community
Stunning waterfront lifestyle with resort-like ambiance
This residence offers a rare opportunity to enjoy true beachfront living in a spacious layout, perfect for families seeking comfort, privacy, and direct access to the beach in one of Dubai’s most iconic coastal addresses.
